comment: Declared Goods ordinary-input route, seed42, standard, zero bots. Static curfew town under its dome, 25 required guards, the Sniper Rifle rack and roof-window lesson, the crater cut and the fresh freight departure. Real human input and server phases; no granted equipment or teleports. Accurate aim does not establish pacing, par, fresh-player or difficulty acceptance.

states.name: tunnel_arrival
states.note: Arrive from the transit tunnel under the pressure dome: shutters down, dark windows, the curfew chime.

states.name: depot_tower_from_tunnel
states.note: From the tunnel mouth the depot's radial tower stands over the town blocks, across the crater: the level's compass.

states.name: ring_supplies
states.note: The personal Rifle a practice entry needs and finite Bullets at the tunnel mouth. The Shotgun waits on its stall ahead, and taking it wakes the patrol.

states.name: ring_shotgun_pickup
states.note: The ordinary Shotgun pickup wakes the curfew patrol and selects the found weapon. The following street fight explicitly selects Rifle after this pickup.

states.name: curfew_patrol
states.note: Taking the Shotgun wakes the curfew patrol: three Clerks come down the ring among the stalls and porches at close to middle distance.

states.name: curfew_patrol_sweepers
states.note: The patrol's two Sweepers hold Rifle distance around the stalls. Take the finite Shells stock on the ordinary approach, then answer the held sightline with the already found Rifle.

states.name: ring_arrival
states.note: The cleared ring's real Arrival at the bend toward the market.

states.name: vault_plaza
states.note: Two Notaries hold dome height over the market while three Clerks fight from behind the vault barriers.

states.name: plaza_arrival
states.note: The plaza's real Arrival, facing the side street.

states.name: window_breath
states.note: The quiet side street. Behind the only lit window a woman taps the glass twice and points toward the square. No caption and no speech.

states.name: curfew_post
states.note: The curfew post assault opens at the side street: two Clerks on the square's west side.

states.name: curfew_post_gate
states.note: Across the square two more Clerks and the Turret on the balcony over the gate hold the post.

states.name: post_arrival
states.note: Inside the cleared post. The real Arrival lights the curfew lamps one at a time toward the cut.

states.name: lamp_line
states.note: From the square the lamp line burns across the post and on toward the cut.

states.name: sniper_rack
states.note: The confiscated long arms: the Sniper Rifle and a finite Cells stock through the normal supply path.

states.name: post_upper
states.note: Up the lamp stair to the post's upper room and its roof window over the cut.

states.name: rim_lesson
states.note: Step up to the sill and hold until the marksman's glint begins, drop off the step until the server cancels that windup, then rise and take it with one scoped Sniper shot across the cut.

states.name: window_arrival
states.note: The window lesson's real Arrival on the firing step.

states.name: overlook_port
states.note: The roof overlook: the view back over the dome and the port's cranes below. The cut is still quiet.

states.name: cut_sweepers
states.note: Entering the cut wakes it. Behind the first shield no marksman sees the participant; two Sweepers come in behind from the cut's end bays and hold Rifle distance. The already found Sniper Rifle answers their exposed bodies using the finite Cells stock.

states.name: cut_berm_sweepers
states.note: The two berm Sweepers hold the gaps beyond Shotgun reach. The same finite Sniper Rifle loadout answers them from the shield.

states.name: cut_marksman_b
states.note: Peek the shield's west end, where one marksman alone watches, and take it scoped.

states.name: cut_marksman_e
states.note: The east end of the same shield answers the far marksman.

states.name: cut_marksman_d
states.note: Through the first gap toward the next marksman.

states.name: cut_marksman_c
states.note: North behind the second berm row.

states.name: cut_marksman_a
states.note: The last marksman, far to the west, from the berm's west end.

states.name: rim_climb
states.note: Up the ramp to the rim: the cleared cut and the curfew town under its dome behind.

states.name: depot_arrival
states.note: The living ready party reaches the freight intake and the actual local departure prompt.

states.name: freight_departure
states.note: A fresh ordinary Use confirms the shared departure into the depot.
